title.narrative: Enhancing Youth Integration and Gender Equality for Improved Livelihoods Project

description.narrative: The Strategy is implemented across Tanzania by the Tanzania Youth Coalition (TYC) through its countrywide network of members, associates, and community youth groups. Its main purpose is to enhance the political, social, and economic empowerment of young women and men, ensuring they enjoy their rights, access opportunities, and live healthy, violence-free and poverty-free lives. The Strategy focuses on strengthening youth capacities through skills development, organizational support, and evidence-based advocacy. It integrates key cross-cutting priorities including gender equality, social inclusion, environmental sustainability, disability inclusion, good governance, , and climate change adaptation reflecting the needs expressed by TYC's beneficiaries. Expected results include increased youth participation in decision-making, expanded livelihood and income-generating opportunities, strengthened youth cooperatives and savings groups, improved entrepreneurship and employability skills, improved access to health and nutrition information for out-of-school youth, and reduced vulnerability to violence and exclusion. The primary target group is young women and men across both rural and urban settings. Main activities include cooperative and savings group promotion, entrepreneurship and vocational training, peace and security awareness (including counter-terrorism sensitization), climate and environmental education, health and nutrition outreach, rights awareness, and community engagement. The Strategy also strengthens TYC's internal systems to enhance sustainability and effective contribution to national youth development efforts.
